notes.title: Silent Call
notes.content: Come and visit our hospital? okay?

notes.title: Periodic update
notes.content:
Update game graphics and filters
Improved the graphics quality of the game

Updated core gameplay for Zone C
Updated core gameplay in Zone B

Fix bugs in some particles and bugs caused by pauses

The sound in area A can be heard
The bugs in area D and outpatient area have been fixed

Fixed some other bugs and optimized them

notes.title: A small update
notes.content:
Fixed possible bugs in the morgue after use the radio

Added a note in Block D
This note is at the front of the elevator
If you try to read it, it may give you some useful information to help you continue to find the next mission~

notes.title: Block D and C Bugs repair
notes.content:
Fixed the problem of collision in Block D that everyone concerned about
Fixed the problem of no guidance in Block C that everyone concerned about

You will get a task after finding a lockbox Block C
The current mission can be seen on the left side of the Inventory UI
Click to see a detailed description of the current mission

After that, you can carefully investigate and find notes containing passwords in Block C
(The generation of these notes is random and will disappear and reappear after a period of time,
As time goes on, there will be more and more notes and more enemies you will see.)

Fixed some problems that could not got steam achievements

notes.title: the Lost Note Paper! Emergency FIXED 1.0
notes.content:
Thank you for your feedback and suggestions!

Fixed the problem of collision detection in Block D, which caused that the task note could not be generated

(the paper strip in Block D can be found normally now)

Fixed the problem that the door of the cabinet would get stuck when the cabinet was opened

notes.title: Today! The internal test and repair of the game are completed! Tomorrow！
notes.content:
Through our unremitting efforts！

All major bugs and details have been completely fixed today!

We have also optimized the gameplaying and added a lot of game content!


Blood hospital can finally be officially RELEASE at tomorrow!

Coming soon!


Finally, thank you for the suggestions and support provided by the internal test players during this period days!

Thank you for your attention!

notes.title: Optimize the game experience and fix bugs and postpone the release of games
notes.content:
It is expected to be available after August 29~
Thank you for your attention and support！
